calibration.constraints: nonnegative on spread, negative squeeze and capture

limitations.calibration: Fit year-over-year quarterly retail-margin changes to weighted aggregate weekly-feature changes. Standardized ridge alpha=2; nonnegative coefficients on all three signed features; unpenalized intercept; fixed 0.5 production-style shrinkage and prior-year same-quarter company-margin anchor.
limitations.evaluation: Expanding-window held-out company targets; compare production on exactly the same eligible quarters. Current-capture historical prices, demand and static weights mean this is NOT historical PIT validation or an independent test of hypotheses already developed on this history.
limitations.gallon_weights: EIA weekly national finished-gasoline products supplied times days of ISO week inside quarter, normalized to one; within-week uniform-rate assumption and store-count regional exposure proxy, not company gallon observations
limitations.quarter_boundary: Include initial partial ISO week. For the final partial ISO week lacking a complete in-quarter price/demand pair, persist the prior complete week's prices and demand and mark every such day imputed. No internal-gap filling or long-horizon projections.
limitations.replacement_cost: 50% current plus 50% previous complete regional weekly wholesale spot price; delivered cost, freight, taxes and discounts unobserved
limitations.retail: Observed EIA regional regular retail prices, not observed MUSA pump prices
limitations.selection: One fixed specification; no lag, half-life, alpha, sign or shrinkage searches against outcomes
limitations.state: squeeze and capture states each retain 50% of prior week's state plus current impulse; never reset at quarter boundary
limitations.warmup: Require eight consecutive valid weekly state transitions before the first quarter week; residual initial-state influence below 1/256
limitations.weekly_margin_allocation: Quarterly seasonal anchor plus shrunken calibrated contribution of each week's features relative to prior-year aggregate; volume-weighted weekly predictions must exactly equal the quarter prediction. These are latent calibrated allocations, not identified company monthly/weekly margins.
limitations.weekly_uncertainty: Quarterly supervision does not identify unique weekly company economics; fitted coefficients are not causal estimates
